about.en: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. is a US holding company whose subsidiaries span insurance (including GEICO), the BNSF railroad, utilities and energy, manufacturing and retail, alongside a large portfolio of listed equities. BRK.B represents its Class B common shares on the NYSE, which carry a fraction of the economic and voting rights of a Class A share (BRK.A) and trade at a much lower price; derivative markets may quote them as BRKB.
